_comment: Known Zeliard assembly addresses for breakpoint presets. Segment:Offset in real-mode DOS. Game engine segment = 0AC6 in DOSBox-X (041F in Spice86).

title_blit.desc: Title logo blit — writes nibble-packed bytes to VGA A000:0, exact blit with mask tables

title_blit_alt.desc: Alt entry to same blit function

4plane_interleaver.desc: 4-plane interleaver — converts 2-plane 1bpp source to nibble-packed render buffer

grp_decode_entry.desc: GRP decode pipeline entry — calls RLE 6DE1, then interleaver, then blit

rle_6de1.desc: Image RLE decoder (NOT fill_buffer) — 1-byte and 2-byte modes for image source data

fill_buffer_dispatch.desc: fill_buffer dispatch table — opcode bits 2:0 select decompression algorithm

chunk_loader.desc: Chunk loader — AL=2: SAR+fill_buffer decode, AL=3: raw load; SI=ref ptr, DI=dest

palette_set.desc: VGA palette setup — 3-plane×2-bit format, 64 colors; called during scene transitions

set_vga_palette.desc: Gameplay palette — computes 64 DAC entries from 8 base RGB × 8 shade offsets via INT 10h AX=1010h

opening_slideshow.desc: Opening cinematic slideshow loop — iterates image list at 0x311E

image_decode.desc: Opening scene image decode — ctrl bytes + XOR differential decode on 2-bit pairs

driver_fn4.desc: Graphics driver function 4 — palette switching (call via [cs:0x3008])
